claimBoundary.coreClaim: A normalized message patch uses the collection journal when it does not change message identity, visible content, character ownership, swipe selection, or semantic swipe-scoped metadata.

string-encoded and object-form swipe extra metadata

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Every generic message update materialized swipes and called update_collections_atomically, rewriting the full messages and message-swipes primaries even when only memory status or other parent metadata changed.
contractLaneGate.consumer: Conversation and Roleplay generation, prompt-snapshot retention, and automatic memory capture
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Metadata-only updates must remain durable without paying the cost of replacing unrelated message and swipe rows.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The Rust owner rejects all identity, content, character, and swipe fields from the fast path, semantically compares string-encoded or object-form active swipe metadata, strips unchanged swipe-owned keys from the parent patch, and records the remaining mutation in the existing collection journal.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src-tauri owns message normalization, swipe sidecars, atomic content edits, and journal durability.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not skip memory status or prompt metadata writes, weaken durability, or hide the wait with UI state.
regressionProof: The focused test asserts that a full projected extra patch containing an unchanged prompt snapshot plus new memory status leaves both primary files byte-for-byte unchanged.
The same test asserts that the new parent metadata is readable, the prompt snapshot still materializes from its sidecar, and the messages pending journal exists.
Existing content-edit and message-swipe suites prove swipe-owned mutations remain atomic.

positiveRows.claim: Unchanged swipe-owned prompt data plus new parent memory metadata uses the durable journal.
The projected response still contains the active prompt snapshot and stored reads contain the new memory status.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused regression materializes the updated row and checks both values.
